WITH v AS (
  SELECT itsm.set_rls_context(
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.realm || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}','')
  ) AS realm_id
),
params AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ String($json.realm || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS realm_key,
    '{{ String($json.dt || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS dt,
    '{{ String($json.start_utc || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::timestamptz AS start_utc,
    '{{ String($json.end_utc || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::timestamptz AS end_utc,
    '{{ String($json.as_of || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::timestamptz AS as_of
),
m AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM itsm.sla_metrics_at((SELECT as_of FROM params))
),
overall AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc) AS receipt_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc) AS responded_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc) AS resolved_count,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE m.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m.response_target_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ) AS response_sla_total_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE m.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m.response_target_minutes IS NOT NULL
        AND m.response_breached = true
    ) AS response_sla_breached_count,

    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m.resolution_target_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ) AS resolution_sla_total_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
      WHERE COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m.resolution_target_minutes IS NOT NULL
        AND m.resolution_breached = true
    ) AS resolution_sla_breached_count
  FROM m
  CROSS JOIN params p
),
by_type AS (
  SELECT
    resource_type,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'receipt_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.started_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc),
      'responded_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc),
      'resolved_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc),

      'response_sla_total_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE m.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
          AND m.response_target_minutes IS NOT NULL
      ),
      'response_sla_breached_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE m.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
          AND m.response_target_minutes IS NOT NULL
          AND m.response_breached = true
      ),

      'resolution_sla_total_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
          AND m.resolution_target_minutes IS NOT NULL
      ),
      'resolution_sla_breached_count', COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
          AND m.resolution_target_minutes IS NOT NULL
          AND m.resolution_breached = true
      )
    ) AS metrics
  FROM m
  CROSS JOIN params p
  GROUP BY resource_type
),
by_type_json AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(resource_type, metrics), '{}'::jsonb) AS by_resource_type
  FROM by_type
)
SELECT
  p.dt,
  p.realm_key AS realm,
  p.as_of,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'schema_version', 1,
    'realm', p.realm_key,
    'dt', p.dt,
    'as_of', p.as_of,

    'receipt_count', o.receipt_count,
    'responded_count', o.responded_count,
    'resolved_count', o.resolved_count,

    'response_p50_minutes', (
      SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.response_minutes)
      FROM m m2
      WHERE m2.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m2.response_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ),
    'response_p95_minutes', (
      SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.response_minutes)
      FROM m m2
      WHERE m2.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m2.response_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ),

    'resolution_p50_minutes', (
      SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.resolution_minutes)
      FROM m m2
      WHERE COALESCE(m2.closed_at, m2.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m2.resolution_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ),
    'resolution_p95_minutes', (
      SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.resolution_minutes)
      FROM m m2
      WHERE COALESCE(m2.closed_at, m2.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m2.resolution_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ),

    'response_sla_total_count', o.response_sla_total_count,
    'response_sla_breached_count', o.response_sla_breached_count,
    'response_sla_attainment', (
      CASE
        WHEN o.response_sla_total_count > 0 THEN
          (o.response_sla_total_count - o.response_sla_breached_count)::numeric / o.response_sla_total_count::numeric
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ),

    'resolution_sla_total_count', o.resolution_sla_total_count,
    'resolution_sla_breached_count', o.resolution_sla_breached_count,
    'resolution_sla_attainment', (
      CASE
        WHEN o.resolution_sla_total_count > 0 THEN
          (o.resolution_sla_total_count - o.resolution_sla_breached_count)::numeric / o.resolution_sla_total_count::numeric
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ),

    'mttr_incident_p50_minutes', (
      SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.resolution_minutes)
      FROM m m2
      WHERE m2.resource_type = 'incident'
        AND COALESCE(m2.closed_at, m2.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m2.resolution_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ),
    'mttr_incident_p95_minutes', (
      SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2.resolution_minutes)
      FROM m m2
      WHERE m2.resource_type = 'incident'
        AND COALESCE(m2.closed_at, m2.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
        AND m2.resolution_minutes IS NOT NULL
    ),

    'by_resource_type', (SELECT by_resource_type FROM by_type_json)
  )::text AS metrics_json
FROM params p
CROSS JOIN overall o;

WITH v AS (
  SELECT itsm.set_rls_context(
    NULLIF('{{ String($json.realm || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}','')
  ) AS realm_id
),
params AS (
  SELECT
    '{{ String($json.realm || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS realm_key,
    '{{ String($json.dt || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::text AS dt,
    '{{ String($json.start_utc || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::timestamptz AS start_utc,
    '{{ String($json.end_utc || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::timestamptz AS end_utc,
    '{{ String($json.as_of || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::timestamptz AS as_of
),
m AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM itsm.sla_metrics_at((SELECT as_of FROM params))
),
events AS (
  SELECT
    jsonb_build_object(
      'event_id', CONCAT(m.resource_type, ':', m.resource_id::text, ':response:', p.dt),
      'event_type', 'sla_response',
      'event_at', m.first_response_at,
      'realm', p.realm_key,
      'dt', p.dt,
      'resource_type', m.resource_type,
      'resource_id', m.resource_id,
      'resource_number', m.resource_number,
      'service_id', m.service_id,
      'priority', m.priority,
      'sla_target_key', m.sla_target_key,
      'target_minutes', m.response_target_minutes,
      'started_at', m.started_at,
      'observed_at', m.response_observed_at,
      'due_at', m.response_due_at,
      'elapsed_minutes', m.response_minutes,
      'paused_minutes', m.response_pause_minutes,
      'breached', m.response_breached
    ) AS event,
    m.first_response_at AS event_at
  FROM m
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE m.first_response_at BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    jsonb_build_object(
      'event_id', CONCAT(m.resource_type, ':', m.resource_id::text, ':resolution:', p.dt),
      'event_type', 'sla_resolution',
      'event_at', COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at),
      'realm', p.realm_key,
      'dt', p.dt,
      'resource_type', m.resource_type,
      'resource_id', m.resource_id,
      'resource_number', m.resource_number,
      'service_id', m.service_id,
      'priority', m.priority,
      'sla_target_key', m.sla_target_key,
      'target_minutes', m.resolution_target_minutes,
      'started_at', m.started_at,
      'observed_at', m.resolution_observed_at,
      'due_at', m.resolution_due_at,
      'elapsed_minutes', m.resolution_minutes,
      'paused_minutes', m.resolution_pause_minutes,
      'breached', m.resolution_breached
    ) AS event,
    COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at) AS event_at
  FROM m
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE COALESCE(m.closed_at, m.resolved_at) BETWEEN p.start_utc AND p.end_utc
)
SELECT
  p.dt,
  p.realm_key AS realm,
  p.as_of,
  COALESCE(string_agg(e.event::text, E'\n' ORDER BY e.event_at), '') ||
    CASE WHEN COUNT(e.event) > 0 THEN E'\n' ELSE '' END AS events_jsonl,
  COUNT(e.event) AS events_count
FROM params p
LEFT JOIN events e ON true
GROUP BY p.dt, p.realm_key, p.as_of;

parameters.content:
### env（最小）

- `N8N_REALM`（default: `default`）
- `N8N_S3_BUCKET`（required）
- `N8N_S3_PREFIX`（default: `itsm/service_management`）
- `N8N_METRICS_TARGET_DATE`（optional: `YYYY-MM-DD`）

### DB（n8n credentials）

- Postgres credential 名: `RDS Postgres`
- SoR に `itsm.sla_metrics_at(p_at)` が適用済みであること（`apps/itsm_core/sor_ops/sql/itsm_sor_core.sql`）
